title: Project overview
description: Read the scope and local-run instructions first. This is a client-only marketing reconstruction, not a transactional service.

title: Content and images
description: Understand the seven Space records and their shared media configuration before changing presentation. Contact destinations are public links; no backend owns these records.

title: React entry and state
description: Follow the root mount and App composition. Gallery selection and the contact-dialog reference live at the page level; hero selection and menu state are local.

title: Style and accessibility
description: Read the base stylesheet followed by the refinement layer. Shared focus, reduced motion, responsive layout and dialog rules work together.

title: Build and preview
description: The bundler reuses installed tools, then the preview serves dist. Source edits require an explicit build when dist already exists.

title: Verification and limits
description: Review local checks and historical evidence separately from this static analysis. Browser tests need a running local server and the sibling Playwright installation.
